goal:
The catalog listing pages look short — with 4 items per page I only ever get 3, and
every page is missing its last item. Worse, some products never show up in the listing
at all. It smells like the pagination slices are off by one somewhere, but the page
numbers themselves look right.

hows.text: Implement a robust, zero-indexed slice with explicit boundary checks and a final page adjustment, ensuring the last item is always included and preventing out-of-range indexing.
hows.reason: This directly addresses the missing last item and off-by-one slicing by enforcing strict index boundaries and correcting the final page calculation.

hows.text: Audit the underlying data source and query logic to guarantee all products are fully loaded and filtered correctly before applying the pagination slice, resolving missing items at the source.
hows.reason: This tackles the missing products by verifying data completeness and filtering logic, ensuring the catalog accurately reflects all available items before pagination.
